solver.dispatch: fixed consecutive windows; independent task budgets; no cross-task state; drain window on exception, stop new windows; no retry

learning.selection: After all answers locked: earliest two tasks per subject with at least one CONFIRMED_WRONG; use earliest wrong attempt only. No replacement, no later correct solution, no source hidden score to generation. Balanced arm order by chosen-source index.

evaluation: All candidates frozen before Worker execution; source-only score. Model-generated parameter schema/mapping. No independent transfer or routing claims. No generated test used as oracle.
not_sent: Review input preflight rejection records TASK_NOT_COMPLETED and continues; no retry/no feedback/no synthesis from unlocked task.
authorization: User requests100–200highest-difficulty diverse tasks and rerun; current finite140 plan; no previous-budget transfer
